# Inline

| Kind | Sample |
| --- | --- |
| bold | **bold text** and __also bold__ |
| italic | *italic text* and _also italic_ |
| strike | ~~struck out~~ |
| code | `a \| b` and `plain` |
| link | [the guide](https://example.com/guide) |
| image | ![dot](./dot.png) inline |
| kbd | Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>K</kbd> |
| mixed | **bold *nested italic* bold** with `code` and [link](https://example.com) |
